comment: Independent C-first recipe for timeout.c begin_burn() on a magic lamp whose age is negative. Segment 1 wishes for a magic lamp on turn 1, waits 300 turns, drops it on Dlvl 5's up stairs and dies there, saving bones. Segment 2 is a new game that arrives on Dlvl 5 on turn 1, so restore.c getlev() shifts the lamp's age (its creation turn; age_is_relative() excludes magic lamps) to about -300. Applying the cursed lamp flickers out four times and then lights it; begin_burn() ignores a magic lamp's age. New seeds and dates chosen before comparison.
